description: IF women-related target AND sexualized remark or objectification THEN Sexual-Harassment.
IF women-related target AND threat, violent intent, or encouragement of physical harm THEN Violence.
IF women-related target AND gender-based inferiority, exclusion, or stereotype THEN Misogyny.
IF women-related target AND ridicule of face, body, clothing, or physical appearance THEN Appearance-Attack.
IF women-related target AND reputation attack, moral judgement, or derogatory allegation THEN Character-Assassination.
IF a harmful cue directly refers to the identified women-related target THEN increase Explicit-Harm support.
IF the harmful interpretation requires image-text association, cultural knowledge, sarcasm, or indirect implication THEN increase Implicit-Harm support.
IF a harmful expression is quoted or depicted AND explicitly criticized, condemned, or challenged THEN support Non-Harm.
IF the meme raises awareness, provides counter-speech, or reports harm without endorsement THEN support Non-Harm.
IF image, OCR text, retrieved knowledge, and activated rules conflict THEN reduce the neural-symbolic confidence gate.
